name: Easy
description: Spotting a large Ogre crouched behind a small bush might be a **DC 8** Perception check.

name: Medium
description: A hidden doorway behind a bookcase might be a **DC 12** Examination check.

name: Challenging
description: Calming an injured Owlbear stuck in a trap may be a **DC 15** Naturecraft check.

name: Very Difficult
description: Intuiting the true intentions of a trained Spy may be a **DC 18** Insight check.

name: Extremely Difficult
description: Disarming an ancient legendary trap may be a **DC 20+** Finesse check.
